```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.retina = 2)
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readr); library(ggplot2)
library(scales); library(forcats); library(DT)

# Pin the text columns. Inference is per file, and these are single-row files:
# missing_samples is blank for most captures, a sample id for a few, and for a
# capture missing one numerically-named sample it is bare digits -- which reads
# as double and then refuses to bind_rows() with the character ones.
metrics <- lapply(
    snakemake@input[["metrics"]], read_tsv,
    col_types = cols(.default = col_guess(),
                     capture_id      = col_character(),
                     pool_id         = col_character(),
                     missing_samples = col_character())
  ) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  # pool_id is optional in captures.csv; keep the blank distinguishable from a
  # real pool rather than letting it form a phantom group.
  mutate(pool_id = if_else(is.na(pool_id) | !nzchar(pool_id),
                           "(unspecified)", pool_id)) %>%
  arrange(pool_id, capture_id)

n_pools <- metrics %>% filter(pool_id != "(unspecified)") %>% pull(pool_id) %>% n_distinct()

# See report_capture.Rmd: sample_id is character for some captures and numeric
# for others, so pin it rather than letting readr infer per file.
all_cells <- read_tsv(snakemake@input[["all_cells"]],
                      col_types = cols(sample_id = col_character()))

# Capture pages sit in captures/ next to this index.
page <- function(capture) sprintf('<a href="captures/%s.html">%s</a>', capture, capture)
```

`r nrow(metrics)` captures across `r n_pools` pools,
`r comma(sum(metrics$n_barcodes))` barcodes.

## Overview

```{r overview, fig.height=4.5}
metrics %>%
  mutate(capture_id = fct_reorder(capture_id, frac_singlet)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = frac_singlet, y = capture_id, fill = pool_id)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(x = "Singlet rate", y = NULL,
       subtitle = "Coloured by pool; hover the tables below for detail") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5))
```

```{r ambient-overview, fig.height=3.4}
metrics %>%
  select(capture_id, souporcell = ambient_souporcell, vireo = ambient_vireo_median) %>%
  pivot_longer(-capture_id, names_to = "estimator", values_to = "ambient") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimator, y = ambient)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Ambient RNA", subtitle = "Across captures, by estimator") +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r flagged, results='asis'}
short <- metrics %>% filter(n_recovered < n_declared)
if (nrow(short)) {
  cat("\n### Captures missing declared samples\n\n")
  short %>%
    transmute(capture_id, pool_id, declared = n_declared, recovered = n_recovered,
              missing = missing_samples) %>%
    knitr::kable() %>% print()
} else {
  cat("\nAll declared samples were recovered in every capture.\n")
}
```

## By capture {.tabset}

### Table

```{r by-capture}
metrics %>%
  transmute(
    capture = page(capture_id),
    pool = pool_id,
    barcodes = n_barcodes,
    singlet = n_singlet,
    doublet = n_doublet,
    unassigned = n_unassigned,
    `singlet %` = round(100 * frac_singlet, 1),
    declared = n_declared,
    recovered = n_recovered,
    `ambient % (soup)` = round(100 * ambient_souporcell, 2),
    `mean methods agreeing` = round(mean_methods_agreeing, 2)
  ) %>%
  datatable(escape = FALSE, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
            extensions = "Buttons",
            options = list(pageLength = 25, dom = "Bfrtip",
                           buttons = c("copy", "csv"),
                           scrollX = TRUE))
```

## By sample {.tabset}

### Table

One row per sample per capture. Search a sample id to find every capture it
appears in.

```{r by-sample}
all_cells %>%
  left_join(metrics %>% select(capture_id, pool_id), by = "capture_id") %>%
  transmute(
    sample = as.character(sample_id),
    capture = page(capture_id),
    pool = pool_id,
    cells = number_of_cells,
    `% of capture` = fraction_of_all_cells_captured
  ) %>%
  arrange(sample, capture) %>%
  datatable(escape = FALSE, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
            extensions = "Buttons",
            options = list(pageLength = 25, dom = "Bfrtip",
                           buttons = c("copy", "csv"),
                           scrollX = TRUE))
```

### Samples spanning multiple captures

```{r multi-capture}
all_cells %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  summarise(captures = n_distinct(capture_id),
            cells = sum(number_of_cells), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(captures > 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(captures), desc(cells)) %>%
  datatable(rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
            options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE))
```
